text: sorry I don't know if this is even the right number. I'm a childminder and I've got a 6 year old boy staying over while his parents are away. He's had a temperature on and off today. I've been giving him calpol and in between doses he's honestly ok I think, running round with the lego, drinking his squash, chatting nonstop. His eczema has flared up really badly though, dry itchy patches on his arms and behind his knees and he keeps scratching them raw. Then about 20 mins ago I looked at him and his lips were BLUE and I nearly had a heart attack. Then I realised he'd just had one of those blue raspberry ice lollies. I wiped his mouth with a wet cloth and it came off and his lips are pink underneath, it was all on his tongue too. I think that's all it was?? Sorry, I just panicked. He's been weeing normally all day as far as I can tell. I just want to know if I'm doing the right thing and not missing something, I've never had one poorly overnight before
